newsitem.title: USA: Schuller Corp sees Q4 charge of $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Schuller Corp sees Q4 charge of $50 mln.

text.p: Schuller Corp said Friday it will take a pre-tax charge of about $50 million, or about $0.18 per share, for nonrecurring items in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The company said that excluding the charge, it expects to report fourth quarter earnings generally in-line with expectations.
The charge covers facility closure costs, a writedown of automotive moulded parts business and separation expenses, the company said.
Schuller said it would report its results February 10.
